title_as_printed: Relative density measurements of {H2O(1) in CO2(2)}, rho, with their respective difference in density from pure CO2, Drho = rho - rho2, and partial molar volumes approaching infinite dilution, V1inf from T = (318 to 369) K and up to p = 35 MPa (m1 = 0.053 to 0.065 mol kg-1).

footnotes_as_printed.table_note: All expanded uncertainties are reported at a 95% confidence interval. The average uncertainty of the density differences was calculated to be dDrho2 = 0.21 kg m-3.

pressure_note: Cell pressure measured at the vibrating-tube densimeter (Paroscientific Digiquartz transducer); not stated whether gauge or absolute; single-phase sub-saturated H2O in CO2, so total pressure

value.what: density of the {H2O(1) in CO2(2)} mixture (wet CO2)

value2.what: density difference from pure CO2 at the same T,p (pure CO2 density interpolated with a Wagner-type equation), rho - rho2

value3.what: partial molar volume of H2O at infinite dilution in CO2, assumed equal to apparent molar volume (eq. 5)

composition.other_species: Water (component 1) dissolved in CO2 (component 2), gravimetric: molality of H2O m1 in mol per kg CO2 and x1 in mol% are printed in the block label (0.05325 mol/kg = 0.2338 mol%; 0.06468 = 0.2838; 0.06597 = 0.2895); carried into group_rows as water_molality_in_co2 and water_mole_percent_in_co2. m1 uncertainty printed in label: 0.00092, 0.00057, 0.00068 mol/kg. Mixtures are sub-saturated (single CO2-rich phase).

conversion_needs: water content given as molality (mol H2O per kg CO2) and mol%; mole fraction y_H2O = x1/100
volume_basis_note: No volume-defined quantity except density (kg/m3 of the mixture). volume_basis: not_applicable
notes: Each T block has two label rows (T line, then m1 line); group_rows are attached to the T label row and set T and composition for all following data rows until the next T label row. Data rows come in near-replicate pairs at nominal pressures. Printed T 346.236, 346.720, 346.776 K are separate loadings (figure legend merges them). Negative Drho and negative V1inf are printed. Uncertainties split from printed 'value +/- unc' cells; the plus-minus sign is the only change. Printed Drho cells carry no uncertainty (average 0.21 kg/m3). Printed T given as (T +/- 0.005) K.
